finding.title: Hard-coded credential in service configuration
finding.description: A password literal is assigned to the database client configuration.

issue.title: Hard-coded credential in the integration image

comments.author: reviewer
comments.text: Investigation notes. We traced the configuration loader through the start-up path, the container entrypoint and the deployment manifests for every environment. The literal is read by the database client factory when no environment override is present. Staging and production both set the override, but the integration environment does not, and its image is pushed to the shared registry. We checked registry access lists, the pull secrets used by the build agents, and whether any external party can pull that image; only the build service account can. We also reviewed the audit log for the last ninety days and found no pulls from outside the build pool. Conclusion: risk accepted by the platform owner until 2027-06.
